mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.0% and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two-quarter RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% and a decline in CPI inflation below 2.0% over three months signals a restrictive monetary policy with falling inflation, which typically supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.0% and CPIAUCSL crosses below 2.0% within 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during episodes where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index above its previous 12-month maximum over three months signals a supply-side expansion that boosts corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO exceeds previous 12-month maximum and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained INDPRO expansion (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the civilian labor force participation rate above 62.5% over three months signals broader labor supply and potential earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 62.5% and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 62.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the housing starts index above its previous 12-month maximum over three months signals a housing market recovery that boosts consumer confidence and spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST exceeds previous 12-month maximum and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained HOUST expansion (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its previous 12-month minimum over three months signals a sharp demand contraction, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below previous 12-month minimum and remains below for 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three-month RSAFS contraction (t-test p > 0.05).
